lines.en: label dormwarsfive6:
scene sky
One by one, the girls begin to pour out of the library and head over to...wherever we’re going next. I’m not really sure.
lines.zh: 女孩们一个接一个地涌出图书馆，走向……我们接下来要去的地方。我其实不太确定是哪儿。

lines.en: And to be honest, I’m not really excited either.
lines.zh: 而且说实话，我也不怎么期待。

lines.en: Maya still isn’t {i}Maya.{/i} And even if I’m a little more open to her...{i}existence{/i} now than I was in the past, I’m still not fond of the idea of sitting there while she berates me.
lines.zh: Maya 仍然不是那个 {i}Maya{/i}。就算我现在比过去更能接受她的……{i}存在{/i}，我也不喜欢坐在那儿被她痛骂一顿。

lines.en: All I’ll do is project. And trick myself into believing there’s something I can do to get {i}mine{/i} back when I know it isn’t up to me.
lines.zh: 我唯一会做的，就是投射。并欺骗自己相信，有什么办法能把{i}我的{/i}那个她找回来——尽管我知道那不由我决定。

lines.en: I’m curious about how she’ll handle it, though, because she’s walking on eggshells too. And I bet part of her wishes she could just sleep with me and win the contest that way.
lines.zh: 不过我很好奇她会怎么应对，因为她也在小心翼翼。而且我敢打赌，她心里有一部分希望自己能直接跟我上床，用那种方式赢下比赛。

lines.en: Assuming it’ll be a {i}contest{/i} at all, of course. Because when it comes to making me feel bad, there is no one better at it than her.
lines.zh: 当然，前提是这还能算是一场{i}比赛{/i}。因为在让我难受这件事上，没人比她更在行。

lines.en: It only makes sense that the opposite would be true as well.
lines.zh: 那么反过来也理应成立。

lines.en: Somehow or another, I’m still wrapped around her finger — even when she’s nowhere to be found.
lines.zh: 不知怎么的，我依然被她玩弄于股掌之间——即便她根本不在我身边。

lines.en: scene benicetosensei1
: And we’re back! With hopefully another fun competition instead of one where we just make everybody feel bad for a solid hour.
lines.zh: : 我们回来了！希望这一场能是场有趣的比赛，而不是那种让所有人难受一整小时的比赛。

lines.en: : If that happens today, we can assume the contest was a complete failure. I better leave this room feeling better than I ever have before.
lines.zh: : 如果今天真变成那样，那这场比赛就算是彻底失败了。我离开这个房间时，得感觉比以往任何时候都好才行。

lines.en: : It’s against the rules. It was the first thing I thought about as well.
lines.zh: : 那是违反规则的。我也是第一个想到这个的。

lines.en: : Not...what I meant.
lines.zh: : 不……我不是那个意思。

lines.en: : Oh damn. I guess there is chemistry there after all. It’s just never been that apparent to me until right now.
lines.zh: : 哦，靠。看来他们之间还真是有化学反应。只是我之前从没这么明显地看出来。

lines.en: scene benicetosensei2
: We have exchanged one sentence.
lines.zh: : 我们才说了一句话。

lines.en: : Sometimes, that’s all it takes.
lines.zh: : 有时候，一句话就够了。

lines.en: : Uhh...{i}anyway.{/i} The rules of the contest are simple.
lines.zh: : 呃……{i}总之{/i}。比赛规则很简单。

lines.en: scene benicetosensei3
: You’ll both get to spend a total of five minutes with Sensei. Within that time-
lines.zh: : 你们两人各有五分钟和 Sensei 相处的时间。在这段时间里——

lines.en: : Sorry, {i}just{/i} five? The date war girls get like four hours.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，{i}只{/i}有五分钟？约会战争那组可有四个小时呢。

lines.en: : Are you implying you could be nice to this heathen for longer than twenty minutes tops?
lines.zh: : 你是在暗示，你能对这个异教徒好上超过二十分钟？

lines.en: : If he tapes my mouth shut, sure.
lines.zh: : 如果他把我的嘴封上，就可以。

lines.en: scene benicetosensei4
: I’d kind of love to, I won’t lie.
lines.zh: : 说实话我还挺想的，不骗你。

lines.en: : Such a siscon. What would Mom and Dad say if they heard that?
lines.zh: : 真是个妹控。爸妈听到这话会怎么说？

lines.en: : Ohhh, so I’m not the only one here with good {i}chemistry.{/i} Thanks for showing me. I hate it.
lines.zh: : 哦哦哦，原来这里不是只有我有{i}化学反应{/i}。谢谢你让我看明白。我讨厌这个。

lines.en: scene benicetosensei5
: Don’t worry, Maya. I’d still choose you if you were an option.
lines.zh: : 别担心，Maya。如果你是个选项的话，我还是会选你。

lines.en: : You’d be foolish not to. I’m demonstrably better.
lines.zh: : 你不会选才蠢。我明显更好。

lines.en: : Oh, okay. Now {i}I{/i} hate this.
lines.zh: : 哦，好啊。现在轮到{i}我{/i}讨厌这个了。

lines.en: : Either I explain the rules or I get to join in on the flirting too. Take your pick.
lines.zh: : 要么我来讲规则，要么我也加入调情。二选一。

lines.en: scene benicetosensei6
: I’ll go lie down on the couch. You three know what to do from there.
lines.zh: : 我去沙发上躺着。接下来你们三个知道该怎么做。

lines.en: : Imani leaves the room for one minute and his true colors immediately show. That didn’t take very long.
lines.zh: : Imani 才离开一分钟，他的本性就露出来了。真是一点都不慢。

lines.en: : Go ahead, Ayane. Explain your {i}rules{/i} since they’re apparently more complicated than just lying to him until he feels good about himself.
lines.zh: : 讲吧，Ayane。既然你的{i}规则{/i}显然比「骗他直到他自我感觉良好」更复杂，那就讲吧。

lines.en: scene benicetosensei7
: They’re not. The name of the contest pretty accurately sums it up. Just be nice to him and he’ll choose a winner once you’ve both had your turns.
lines.zh: : 并不复杂。比赛的名字已经概括得很准确了。只要对他好，等你们两人都轮完之后，他会选出胜者。

lines.en: : Again- only five minutes, though. We’ve got the lawyer contest next and, if I know anything about the court of law, which I do, I imagine that one will take a while.
lines.zh: : 再说一次——只有五分钟。下一项是律师比赛，而如果我对法庭还有什么了解——我确实有——我想那一场会花上不少时间。

lines.en: : Interesting.
lines.zh: : 有意思。

lines.en: : Okay. Let’s see how this goes. Otoha, would you like the honors of going first?
lines.zh: : 好。那就看看会怎么样吧。Otoha，你想先来吗？

lines.en: : Sure. Just to confirm, though — Tsuneyo will step in when he tries to touch me, right?
lines.zh: : 好啊。不过先确认一下——他想碰我的时候，Tsuneyo 会出手吧？

lines.en: scene benicetosensei8
: Nope! I will. I’ll just ask that everybody leaves the room for ten minutes so I can properly {i}scold{/i} him.
lines.zh: : 不会！我会。我会请大家离开房间十分钟，好让我好好{i}训{/i}他一顿。

lines.en: : I wonder if this is how I looked to everybody at my last school?
lines.zh: : 我在想，我在上一所学校的时候，在别人眼里是不是也是这副样子？

lines.en: : You mean burdened by the weight of everyone’s unquenchable desire?
lines.zh: : 你是说被所有人无法满足的欲望压得喘不过气？

lines.en: : Pretty much, yeah.
lines.zh: : 差不多吧，对。

lines.en: scene black
: We’ll start the clock once you guys are seated!
lines.zh: : 你们一坐下我们就开始计时！

lines.en: : Maya — if you could please step away and refrain from making eye contact with either of them until their time is up, it would be greatly appreciated.
lines.zh: : Maya——在他们的时间结束前，请你退开，并且不要和她们任何人有眼神接触，感激不尽。

lines.en: : Fine. I’ll just be standing over there in the corner...missing my beloved Sensei.
lines.zh: : 行。我就站在那边角落里……思念我亲爱的 Sensei。

lines.en: : Ah! Nope! No head-starts!
lines.zh: : 啊！不行！不许抢跑！

lines.en: : Hm? Head start to what? Why are we here again?
lines.zh: : 嗯？抢什么跑？我们为什么来着？

lines.en: : Sensei, shield your ears! Otoha, do something else!
lines.zh: : Sensei，捂住耳朵！Otoha，干点别的！

lines.en: : Come on, little bro! Let’s sit on the couch and you can tell me about your day.
lines.zh: : 来吧，小老弟！我们坐到沙发上，你跟我讲讲你今天过得怎么样。

lines.en: scene benicetosensei9
: Oh, Io! I didn’t expect you to be here. And I feel kind of bad because Miku just ran off to look for you.
lines.zh: : 哦，Io！没想到你在这儿。我还有点过意不去，因为 Miku 刚刚跑去找你了。

lines.en: : Did she? Why?
lines.zh: : 是吗？为什么？

lines.en: : I think to compensate for how bad she’s currently feeling about herself.
lines.zh: : 我想是为了弥补她此刻对自己的糟糕感觉吧。

lines.en: : Yeah, that makes sense. Anyone would feel better about themselves standing next to me.
lines.zh: : 嗯，说得通。任何人站在我旁边都会自我感觉良好一些。

lines.en: : Not me. If that were true, I’d have a much easier time falling asleep at night by now.
lines.zh: : 我就不会。要是真的，我早就能轻松入睡了。

lines.en: : I’m surprised you don’t after finally kissing-
lines.zh: : 你居然还睡不着，毕竟你终于吻到了——

lines.en: scene benicetosensei10
: {i}SHHHH!!! Are you TRYING to get me killed?! Do you see how many girls are in this room?!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}嘘！！！！你是想害死我吗？！你看看这屋里有多少女生？！{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I am friggin’ DONE for if these people find out someone outside of the top five kissed him!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}要是这些人发现有前五名之外的人吻了他，我就他妈的完蛋了！{/i}

lines.en: : I don’t like that sentence because it implies that Sensei is kissing his niece.
lines.zh: : 我不喜欢这句话，因为它暗示 Sensei 在亲他侄女。

lines.en: scene benicetosensei11
: I mean, would that {i}really{/i} be all that crazy to assume?
lines.zh: : 我是说，那么假设{i}真的{/i}很离谱吗？

lines.en: scene benicetosensei12
: Touka, do you think I’m strange because I want to make out with my dad?
lines.zh: : Touka，你会因为我想和我爸接吻而觉得我奇怪吗？

lines.en: : Yes.
: So you don’t feel that way about {i}your{/i} dad?
lines.zh: : 所以{i}你{/i}对自己的爸爸没有那种感觉？

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 没有。

lines.en: : Hm.
scene benicetosensei13
: He’s probably just not as attractive as mine then, is he?
lines.zh: : 那大概只是因为我爸比你的更有魅力吧？

lines.en: : You have chosen a very peculiar topic to discuss with someone you have extremely limited interactions with.
lines.zh: : 你选了一个非常奇特的话题，来和一个你几乎没什么交集的人讨论。

lines.en: : Well you like Sensei, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 不过你喜欢 Sensei 吧？

lines.en: scene benicetosensei14
: Of course I like him. I’m competing in a contest to earn his favor, am I not?
lines.zh: : 我当然喜欢他。我参加这个比赛就是为了赢得他的青睐，不是吗？

lines.en: : Technically, there isn’t a prize for this year that’s been announced yet.
lines.zh: : 严格来说，今年的奖品还没公布呢。

lines.en: : Yes, but we all know that {i}he{/i} is the reason we do this to begin with. Which is why last year felt so...different when all was said and done.
lines.zh: : 是的，但我们都知道，{i}他{/i}才是我们做这一切的初衷。所以去年一切尘埃落定之后，感觉才那么……不一样。

lines.en: : I wasn’t around for last year’s contest either. Maybe you just missed me?
lines.zh: : 去年的比赛我也不在。也许你只是想我了？

lines.en: scene benicetosensei15
: No...I don’t think that was it.
lines.zh: : 不……我觉得不是因为这个。

lines.en: : You know — I’ve always kind of wanted to get to know you a little better.
lines.zh: : 话说——我一直有点想多了解你一些。

lines.en: : Please tell me it’s not because I remind you of your mother.
lines.zh: : 请别告诉我是因为我让你想起了你母亲。

lines.en: scene benicetosensei16
: {b}{size=+10}HA!{/b}{/size}
lines.zh: : {b}{size=+10}哈！{/size}{/b}

lines.en: scene benicetosensei17
: No, I just mean you’re a really...interesting person. I’ve always wondered what it would be like to just...have {i}everything.{/i}
lines.zh: : 不是，我只是觉得你是个很……有意思的人。我一直在想，要是……拥有{i}一切{/i}会是什么感觉。

lines.en: scene benicetosensei18
: Me and my dad don’t really come from money as I’m sure you’ve seen. We’ve always made pretty much enough to get by, but that’s it.
lines.zh: : 我和我爸其实不算有钱人，这你肯定看得出来。我们一直都只够勉强过日子，仅此而已。

lines.en: : No fancy stuff. No trips anywhere. But you-
lines.zh: : 没有花哨的东西。哪儿也没去过。但你——

lines.en: scene benicetosensei19
: You’ve got it made!
lines.zh: : 你什么都有了！

lines.en: : You don’t even have to work for anything. If you want something, you can just {i}have{/i} it. That’s crazy.
lines.zh: : 你甚至什么都{i}不用{/i}做。想要什么就有什么。太疯狂了。

lines.en: : So you’re interested in my wealth, not {i}me.{/i}
lines.zh: : 所以你感兴趣的是我的财富，不是{i}我{/i}这个人。

lines.en: : Don’t get me wrong, Touka. I’m interested in {i}you{/i} too. Just most of that personal interest is about the relationship you have with my dad.
lines.zh: : 别误会，Touka。我对{i}你{/i}这个人也有兴趣。只是那其中大部分兴趣，是关于你和我爸之间的关系。

lines.en: : Your dad that you...want to French kiss.
lines.zh: : 你那个……你想跟他法式湿吻的爸爸。

lines.en: scene benicetosensei20
: Oh, I want to do way more than that. How about you, though?
lines.zh: : 哦，我想做的可远不止那个。你呢？

lines.en: : I’m not sure that concerns you, Ami. Sensei is a grown man and doesn’t need your approval for anything even if I {i}was{/i} pursuing him, which I am not.
lines.zh: : 我觉得那不关你的事，Ami。Sensei {i}是{/i}个成年人，就算我在追求他，也不需要你的批准——何况我没有。

lines.en: : Oh? And I assume I'm just supposed to believe that?
lines.zh: : 哦？那我就该信了？

lines.en: : I’m sorry — are you trying to {i}intimidate{/i} me right now? I’m somewhat unsure of what to take away from this strange interaction.
lines.zh: : 抱歉——你这是在试图{i}威胁{/i}我吗？我有点不确定该从这场奇怪的互动里得出什么结论。

lines.en: : I’m not really sure either. I can’t tell if I like you more or less now.
lines.zh: : 我也不太确定。我不知道我现在是更喜欢你了，还是更不喜欢了。

lines.en: : You know, I may not remind you of {i}your{/i} mother, but you certainly remind {i}me{/i} of {i}mine.{/i} You’re just significantly worse at what you’re doing than she is.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，我也许不像{i}你{/i}母亲，但你确实让{i}我{/i}想起了{i}我母亲{/i}。只是你做事的水平比她差远了。

lines.en: : Okay, I made up my mind. I do like you less.
lines.zh: : 好，我想明白了。我更不喜欢你了。

lines.en: : That is your prerogative. I will not weigh in on someone I do not yet understand.
lines.zh: : 那是你的特权。我不会去评价一个我还不了解的人。

lines.en: scene benicetosensei21
: Let’s have a nice and fun Dorm Wars, Touka! Good luck!
lines.zh: : 那我们就过一个开心又愉快的宿舍战争吧，Touka！祝你好运！

lines.en: : Such a {i}strange{/i} family.
lines.zh: : 真是{i}奇怪{/i}的一家人。

lines.en: scene benicetosensei22
: So — do I have any shot of winning at all? Or is Romeo going to choose his Juliet no matter what?
lines.zh: : 那么——我到底有没有胜算？还是说罗密欧不管怎样都会选他的朱丽叶？

lines.en: : You have a perfectly good chance at winning as my Juliet is actually Niki.
lines.zh: : 你胜算十足，因为我的朱丽叶其实是 Niki。

lines.en: : Ahh, so Romeo’s just here to brag.
lines.zh: : 啊，所以罗密欧是来炫耀的。

lines.en: : No. I’m just going to fend off any and all discussion about Maya as I’m already dreading having to talk to her for five whole minutes.
lines.zh: : 不。我只是想挡掉一切关于 Maya 的话题，因为光是想到要跟她聊上整整五分钟，我就已经开始发怵了。

lines.en: : And I’m better?
lines.zh: : 那我就更好？

lines.en: : Oh, absolutely.
lines.zh: : 哦，绝对。

lines.en: scene benicetosensei23
: Wait, really?
lines.zh: : 等等，真的吗？

lines.en: : Yeah. I like being around you, Otoha. You’re like a nice break from the insanity that swallows every other aspect of my life.
lines.zh: : 嗯。我喜欢和你待在一起，Otoha。你就像是我生活里吞噬一切的那片疯狂之中，一段惬意的喘息。

lines.en: : I have my moments of insanity too. You’re just not around to see most of them.
lines.zh: : 我也有发疯的时候。只是你大多不在场看不到。

lines.en: scene benicetosensei24
: For example — just last week, I had a four day stretch where I completely forgot to eat and shower because I was so engrossed in my work.
lines.zh: : 比如说——就在上周，我有整整四天完全忘了吃饭和洗澡，因为太沉浸在工作里了。

lines.en: : You’ll be happy to hear I didn’t hit anyone, though. Look at me, Sensei. I’m growing as a person.
lines.zh: : 不过你会很高兴听到，我没有打任何人。看着我，Sensei。我在成长。

lines.en: : You have since taken a shower, correct?
lines.zh: : 那之后你洗过澡了吧？

lines.en: : Several, with my last one being just this morning. And seeing as I’m supposed to be nice to you right now, I give you full permission to be creepy and sniff my hair.
lines.zh: : 洗了好几次，最近一次就在今天早上。既然我现在应该对你温柔一点，那我完全允许你变态一点，闻闻我的头发。

lines.en: : If that happens again, let me know and I’ll come bring you food.
lines.zh: : 如果再发生那种事，告诉我，我来给你送吃的。

lines.en: scene benicetosensei25
: Okay, hold up. This isn’t a “be nice to Otoha” competition. Just sit there and let me say some nice things about you. I practiced all night and only threw up once.
lines.zh: : 好了，打住。这不是「对 Otoha 好一点」比赛。你就坐着，让我说几句你的好话。我练了一整晚，只吐了一次。

lines.en: : I’d rather just talk normally if that’s okay. Forcing niceties out isn’t really going to make me feel good.
lines.zh: : 我更想正常地聊聊天，可以吗。硬挤出客套话并不会真的让我好受。

lines.en: : Nothing’s going to make you feel good. You’re a miserable, {i}miserable{/i} man.
lines.zh: : 什么都不会让你好受。你是个悲惨、{i}悲惨{/i}的男人。

lines.en: scene benicetosensei26
: But you’ve been a wonderful, {i}wonderful{/i} friend.
lines.zh: : 但你是个非常好、{i}非常好{/i}的朋友。

lines.en: : At least if you cut out the terrible, terrible influence you’ve been on me. I used to be such a good girl. Now, I barely even call my parents.
lines.zh: : 至少在你对我施加的那些糟糕、糟糕的影响之外是这样。我以前是个多好的女孩啊。现在，我连给父母打电话都快省了。

lines.en: : And I imagine it’s easiest to just blame me for that, right?
lines.zh: : 而我想，把那一切都怪到我头上最容易，对吧？

lines.en: : Oh, absolutely. There’s nothing I won’t blame you for so long as it makes me feel better about myself. That’s how relationships work, right?
lines.zh: : 哦，绝对。只要能让我自我感觉好一点，什么我都愿意怪你。关系不就是这么运作的吗？

lines.en: : I don’t think so, Otoha.
lines.zh: : 我不这么觉得，Otoha。

lines.en: : Explains why I was such a shitty girlfriend, then.
lines.zh: : 那就能解释为什么我是个那么烂的女朋友了。

lines.en: : You can say that, sure. But I don’t think you {i}or{/i} Rin honestly believe it.
lines.zh: : 你可以这么说，当然。但我觉得你{i}和{/i} Rin 其实都不真的相信。

lines.en: scene benicetosensei27
: She doesn’t. She’s too...compassionate. I don’t think I’ll ever stop blaming myself for letting things go on for as long as they did, though.
lines.zh: : 她不信。她太……宽容了。不过我觉得，我永远都不会停止责怪自己，让那种状态持续了那么久。

lines.en: : Bright side, though. I learned I’m pretty good at fingering, so that’s cool. Maybe either one of your Juliets will let me try it out on them one day?
lines.zh: : 不过往好处想。我发现自己很擅长用手指，那还挺酷的。也许你的哪一位朱丽叶哪天会让我在她们身上试试？

lines.en: : Nothing says “be nice to Sensei” like suggesting you finger his girlfriends.
lines.zh: : 没什么比「建议由你来指交他的女友们」更能体现「对 Sensei 好一点」了。

lines.en: scene benicetosensei28
: Hey, less work for you.
lines.zh: : 嘿，那不是给你省事了嘛。

lines.en: scene benicetosensei29
: On the real, though...how are you doing? Being back and whatnot. Feel weird?
lines.zh: : 不过说真的……你还好吗？回来什么的。感觉怪怪的？

lines.en: : A little bit, yeah.
lines.zh: : 有一点，嗯。

lines.en: : You miss it?
lines.zh: : 你想念吗？

lines.en: : I miss {i}you.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我想{i}你{/i}。

lines.en: : Me specifically? Or “me” as in “everyone?”
lines.zh: : 特指我？还是「你」等于「所有人」？

lines.en: : Everyone. You’re special- just not {i}that{/i} special.
lines.zh: : 所有人。你很特别——只是没{i}那么{/i}特别。

lines.en: : What a coincidence! That’s exactly what you are to me.
lines.zh: : 真巧！你对我来说也是这样。

lines.en: : {size=-3}I’m excited to continue living a life of mutual acceptance beside you that will likely one day progress into a spontaneous makeout session that we both feel really awkward about afterward.{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-3}我很期待能继续在你身边过这种互相接纳的人生，而且它大概有一天会进展成一场即兴的亲热，事后我们俩都会觉得非常尴尬。{/size}

lines.en: : Then what? It destroys our friendship?
lines.zh: : 然后呢？它会毁掉我们的友谊？

lines.en: : That or I poison myself when I realize I can’t live without you.
lines.zh: : 那个，或者我在意识到没有你活不下去的时候把自己毒死。

lines.en: : You’re so cool.
lines.zh: : 你可真酷。

lines.en: : Want to body-swap? I get to fuck your girlfriend and you get to finally be good at something? IE: fingering. Both guitar {i}and{/i} girls.
lines.zh: : 想交换身体吗？我替你上你女朋友，你终于能擅长点什么？也就是：用手指。吉他{i}和{/i}女孩都是。

lines.en: : I’m totally better at fingering than you.
lines.zh: : 我用手指绝对比你强。

lines.en: : Hey — go put Rin out of her misery and we can put that theory to the test.
lines.zh: : 嘿——去把 Rin 从痛苦里解救出来，我们就可以验证一下这个理论了。

lines.en: scene black
: Aaaaand time! Otoha, out! Maya, in!
lines.zh: : 好嘞，时间到！Otoha，出去！Maya，进来！

lines.en: : Damn. Five minutes already? I had so much fun talking to whatshisname that the time just flew right by.
lines.zh: : 靠。已经五分钟了？我跟那个谁谁谁聊天太开心了，时间就这么飞过去了。

lines.en: : Later, Otoha. I’ll never forget that fateful conversation we had on the couch today.
lines.zh: : 回见，Otoha。我永远不会忘记我们今天在沙发上那场宿命般的对话。

lines.en: : What conversation? Who are you?
lines.zh: : 什么对话？你是谁？

lines.en: scene benicetosensei30
: ...and that is the game of Death Ball.
lines.zh: : ……这就是死亡球。

lines.en: : As you can see, all you need to do is defeat the ball itself. This can be done by throwing it into the moon. Do you have any questions?
lines.zh: : 如你所见，你只需要击败球本身。方法是把它扔到月亮上去。有什么问题吗？

lines.en: : Yes. How did a documentary crew manage to conduct interviews with all of you in the future when the future hasn’t occurred yet?
lines.zh: : 有。一支纪录片摄制组是怎么在未来还没发生的时候，就采访到了你们所有人的？

lines.en: : I believe that is called “post-production.” But I have also heard that the camera adds ten years to one’s appearance.
lines.zh: : 我想那叫「后期制作」。不过我也听说过，镜头会给人的外貌加十岁。

lines.en: scene benicetosensei31
: Or does it deduct ten years from one’s lifespan? I can not recall. You would know more about this forbidden technology than I do.
lines.zh: : 还是说它会从人的寿命里扣掉十年？我记不清了。这种禁忌技术你懂得比我多。

lines.en: : It’s neither, Kendo Princess! You’re clearly a time traveler! The proof keeps adding up! The documentary! Your memories! It’s all real!
lines.zh: : 都不是，剑道公主！你分明就是个时间旅行者！证据越来越多！纪录片！你的记忆！全都是真的！

lines.en: scene benicetosensei32
: You are delusional and foolish. If I could travel through time, I would send myself back to  the period in which ramen rose to popularity and experience the boom myself.
lines.zh: : 你既妄想又愚蠢。如果我能穿越时间，我会把自己送回拉面开始流行的那个年代，亲身经历那场热潮。

lines.en: : When...did that rise to popularity again?
lines.zh: : 那是什么时候……又开始流行来着？

lines.en: : World War II.
lines.zh: : 第二次世界大战。

lines.en: scene benicetosensei33
: For the first time in my life, I feel as if it would be best to just keep my mouth shut.
lines.zh: : 这是我人生中第一次觉得，还是闭嘴比较好。

lines.en: : Hey guys, what are- oh shit! Is the documentary finally out?!
lines.zh: : 嘿各位，你们在看什——哦靠！纪录片终于出了？！

lines.en: : Either that or there is a group of girls identical to us who experienced the same events and also filmed a documentary about it.
lines.zh: : 要么是这样，要么就是有一群和我们一模一样的女孩，经历了同样的事件，也拍了一部关于它的纪录片。

lines.en: : This does not matter. Feast your eyes upon how attractive I will remain for the rest of my life.
lines.zh: : 这不重要。尽情欣赏我余生都将保持的这份美貌吧。

lines.en: scene benicetosensei34
: Start it from the beginning. I want to see Uta’s reaction to the reveal again.
lines.zh: : 从头开始放。我想再看一次 Uta 得知真相时的反应。

lines.en: : Tsuneyo! You’re supposed to be helping me prepare for my battle!
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo！你该帮我备战才对！

lines.en: : In a moment, Emerald Guardian. For I would also like to see how attractive I was back in the glory days once more.
lines.zh: : 稍等，翡翠卫士。因为我也想再看看，当年全盛时期的我有多美。

lines.en: : That was a year ago! Just look in the mirror!
lines.zh: : 那是一年前的事了！照镜子不就行了！

lines.en: : Sooooo...five whole minutes.
lines.zh: : 所——以——说……整整五分钟啊。

lines.en: scene benicetosensei35
: I’ve beaten that time before.
lines.zh: : 我以前撑过比这更久的。

lines.en: : You’re not talking about being nice, are you?
lines.zh: : 你说的不是「温柔」吧？

lines.en: : If that’s what the kids are calling it these days, I guess I am.
lines.zh: : 如果现在的年轻人是这么称呼那件事的，那我想是的。

lines.en: scene benicetosensei36
: If I need to be overly nice, I will. The bridge of magpies only opens once a year, and I can see you there on the opposite end, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 如果需要我非常温柔，我会的。鹊桥一年只开一次，而我看见你就站在桥的另一端，Sensei。

lines.en: : {size=-2}Now that you have given me the faintest sliver of hope, I am going to barrage you with niceties and suggestive dialogue so incessantly that you will have no choice but to give me daily semen injections again.{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-2}既然你已经给了我一丝最微弱的希望，我就要用源源不断的柔情蜜意和暗示性台词狂轰滥炸你，逼得你别无选择，只能重新让我每天给你注射精液。{/size}

lines.en: : You’re starting to sound like Noriko did when she came back.
lines.zh: : 你说话开始有点像 Noriko 回来那时候了。

lines.en: scene benicetosensei37
: Nevermind, I hate you!
lines.zh: : 算了，我恨你！

lines.en: scene benicetosensei38
: Just kidding. Here. Want to jingle the bell? That always cheers you up, doesn’t it?
lines.zh: : 开玩笑的。给。想摇摇铃铛吗？那总能让你开心起来，不是吗？

lines.en: : Not sure if it’ll have the same effect when my mouth isn’t full, but I’m willing to try anything at this point.
lines.zh: : 不确定我嘴里没东西的时候还有没有同样效果，不过事到如今我什么都愿意试。

lines.en: : My Maya wouldn’t say that.
lines.zh: : 我的 Maya 不会说那种话。

lines.en: scene benicetosensei39
: Not even in private? Really?
lines.zh: : 私下里也不说？真的？

lines.en: : Never. She was cold through and through.
lines.zh: : 从不。她从头到脚都是冷的。

lines.en: : Well, what was I like during sex then?
lines.zh: : 那我床上的时候是什么样子？

lines.en: : We never...did that. At least...not until the end.
lines.zh: : 我们从来没……做过那个。至少……到最后之前没有。

lines.en: : So you...
lines.zh: : 所以你……

lines.en: : We were...together...
lines.zh: : 我们……在一起……

lines.en: : But we didn’t have sex.
lines.zh: : 但我们没上过床。

lines.en: : That’s right.
lines.zh: : 没错。

lines.en: : And you were okay with that.
lines.zh: : 而你对此没意见。

lines.en: : I was.
lines.zh: : 没有。

lines.en: scene benicetosensei40
: And you’re 100%% sure “your Maya” looked like this.
lines.zh: : 而你 100%% 确定「你的 Maya」长这样。

lines.en: : Of course. You have the same body. Same eyes. Same everything.
lines.zh: : 当然。同样的身体。同样的眼睛。什么都一样。

lines.en: : Sorry, I’m just having a hard time wrapping my head around a reality in which we are together but you can resist me. {i}Look at me.{/i} What are you thinking right now?
lines.zh: : 抱歉，我只是很难想象出这样一个现实——我们在一起，而你还能忍得住不碰我。{i}看着我。{/i}你此刻在想什么？

lines.en: : Of jingling the bell in the impure way.
lines.zh: : 在想以不纯洁的方式摇那个铃铛。

lines.en: : Exactly.
lines.zh: : 就是嘛。

lines.en: scene benicetosensei41
: So why the fuck would-
lines.zh: : 那他妈的为什么——

lines.en: : Because it didn’t matter. And also...because she wouldn’t let me.
lines.zh: : 因为那不重要。而且……因为她不肯让我碰。

lines.en: scene benicetosensei42
: Huh?
: She thought it would reset {i}me.{/i} And that was understandably not a risk she was willing to take after spending so long trying to find me.
lines.zh: : 她觉得那会让{i}我{/i}重置。而在花了那么久才找到我之后，她不愿冒这个险，那是可以理解的。

lines.en: scene benicetosensei43
: That would make a really good manga.
lines.zh: : 那会是个很棒的漫画题材。

lines.en: : That’s all you have to say?
lines.zh: : 你就只能说这个？

lines.en: : Right now, yeah.
lines.zh: : 现在来说，是的。

lines.en: : And if you knew everything that was going on inside of my head, you’d completely understand why I can’t immediately come up with whatever answer you want.
lines.zh: : 而且如果你知道我脑子里在想些什么，你就会完全明白，为什么我没法立刻说出你想听的那个答案。

lines.en: : This is just as hard for me as it is for you, you know. You’re...the only person I’ve ever felt {i}anything{/i} for and you just...don’t even see me anymore. It sucks.
lines.zh: : 这对你我一样难，你知道的。你……是我唯一对之有过{i}感情{/i}的人，而你……已经看不见我了。糟透了。

lines.en: : It...{i}really{/i} sucks.
lines.zh: : {i}真的{/i}……糟透了。

lines.en: scene benicetosensei44
: You know what? No! You be nice to {i}me!{/i} I’ve earned it!
lines.zh: : 你知道吗？不！换你来对{i}我{/i}好！这是我应得的！

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : Yeah! It’s the Be Nice to Maya Battle now! Spoil me! Pat my head! Do it or I’ll cry!
lines.zh: : 对！现在是对 Maya 好一点大赛！宠我！摸我的头！不然我就哭！

lines.en: : Do you even know how to cry?
lines.zh: : 你连哭都不会吧？

lines.en: : I can figure it out!
lines.zh: : 我可以学着会！

lines.en: : Ugh...god fucking damn it.
lines.zh: : 呃……他妈的该死。

lines.en: scene benicetosensei45
: Oh good, you’re already caving. I don’t like yelling.
lines.zh: : 哦好，你已经在让步了。我不喜欢大吼大叫。

lines.en: : I just fucking hate how cute you are. It’s like wanting to hug a bear. I know you’ll eat me alive, but...I just can’t help it.
lines.zh: : 我只是他妈的恨你这么可爱。就像想抱一头熊。我知道你会把我活活吃掉，但……我就是忍不住。

lines.en: : You never could. And you want to know why, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你从来都忍不住。而你想知道为什么吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : Not if it’s just going to be you bragging about how adorable you are again.
lines.zh: : 如果又要听你吹嘘自己多可爱，那就不必了。

lines.en: scene benicetosensei46
: It’s because {i}you-{/i}
scene benicetosensei47
: And {i}me-{/i}
scene benicetosensei48
: Belong together.
lines.zh: : 是属于彼此的。

lines.en: : How’s that for nice?
lines.zh: : 这够温柔了吗？

lines.en: : I’d give it a B. Not wordy enough.
lines.zh: : 我给 B。不够长篇大论。

lines.en: : You’re only saying that because “your Maya” had millions of years to improve her dialogue and I’ve spent most of {i}my{/i} time learning where you like being bitten.
lines.zh: : 你这么说，只是因为「你的 Maya」有几百万年来打磨她的台词，而{i}我{/i}大部分时间都花在弄明白你喜欢被咬在哪里。

lines.en: : I’ll get better if you let me, though.
lines.zh: : 不过如果你肯给我机会，我会进步的。

lines.en: : You won’t even recognize me by the time we’re done.
lines.zh: : 等我们结束的时候，你会认不出我的。

lines.en: scene black
: Yeah, I...
: I don’t think that’s possible...
lines.zh: : 我觉得那不可能……

lines.en: scene benicetosensei49
: That’s so weird...
lines.zh: : 好奇怪……

lines.en: : They look so-
lines.zh: : 她们看起来好——

lines.en: : Natural? I know. I hate it.
lines.zh: : 自然？我知道。我讨厌这样。

lines.en: scene benicetosensei50
: You too, obviously. I know you and Sensei-
lines.zh: : 你也是，显然。我知道你和 Sensei——

lines.en: : Never like them.
lines.zh: : 永远比不上她们。

lines.en: scene benicetosensei51
: I kind of despise it, if we’re being totally honest. Which we probably shouldn’t be since we barely know each other.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我有点厌恶这回事。虽然我们其实不该这么坦白，毕竟我们才刚认识。

lines.en: : There’s just a point where fighting an unwinnable battle {i}gets{/i} to someone. And I think I’m there.
lines.zh: : 只是，打一场赢不了的仗，总有把人{i}打垮{/i}的时候。而我想我已经到了。

lines.en: : I don’t like watching those two anymore. It feels like one of them hasn’t earned it.
lines.zh: : 我已经不喜欢再看她们两个了。感觉像是其中一个人没有付出足够的代价。

lines.en: scene benicetosensei52
: Sorry about that. I don’t really want to drag you into my drama. There’s just only so much a bottle can hold, you know?
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我不太想把你也拖进我的破事里。只是一个瓶子能装的东西就那么多，你懂吧？

lines.en: : Yeah...
scene benicetosensei53
: Anyway! It looks like Maya’s time is up, so-
lines.zh: : 总之！看来 Maya 的时间也到了，那么——

lines.en: : We {i}can{/i} talk if you want, Ayane. We don’t need to be good friends to-
lines.zh: : 你想聊的话我们可以聊，Ayane。我们不必非得是好朋友才{i}能{/i}——

lines.en: scene benicetosensei54
: I’m fine. But thank you, Otoha. I really appreciate that.
lines.zh: : 我没事。不过谢谢你，Otoha。真的很感激。

lines.en: scene black
: BZZZZZT! Maya’s time is up now too! Off the couch! Come on! Get up!
lines.zh: : 哔哔哔！Maya 的时间也到了！从沙发上下来！快点！起来！

lines.en: Ayane drags Otoha to the middle of the room as Maya and I pull ourselves from the couch.
lines.zh: Ayane 把 Otoha 拽到房间中央，而 Maya 和我从沙发上撑起身来。

lines.en: scene benicetosensei55
There are a few other girls in the room, but none of them seem to be paying much attention. And I imagine it’s because they assume I’ve already made up my mind.
lines.zh: 屋里还有几个别的女生，但似乎都没有太在意。我想那是因为她们以为我已经做出决定了。

lines.en: I really haven’t, though. It’s {i}hard{/i} to when I’m meant to judge what makes me happy and I’ve never really {i}understood{/i} that.
lines.zh: 可我真的没有。这很{i}难{/i}——当我该判断的是什么让我幸福，而我从来就没真正{i}弄懂{/i}过那是什么。

lines.en: A game is a game, though. And it’s not as if this one can end in a tie. So I’ll just...need to make a choice.
lines.zh: 不过比赛就是比赛。而且这一场又不可能以平局收场。所以我只需要……做出选择。

lines.en: : Okay, Sensei! You’ve now experienced five minutes of somewhat private kindness from floor one and floor two!
lines.zh: : 好了，Sensei！你现在已经体验了一楼和二楼各五分钟的、半私密的温柔！

lines.en: : But, like many times before, the time has come to decide on a winner!
lines.zh: : 但就像以往很多次那样，决定胜者的时刻到了！

lines.en: : So who will it be?
lines.zh: : 那么会是谁呢？

lines.en: : Who makes you the happiest?
lines.zh: : 谁让你最幸福？

lines.en: menu:
Maya
lines.zh: Maya

lines.en: $ dormwars5floor1points += 1
$ mayahappywin = True
: It’s a tough choice, but...
lines.zh: : 这是个艰难的选择，不过……

lines.en: : I...think I have to go with Maya.
lines.zh: : 我……想我得选 Maya。

lines.en: scene benicetosensei56
: Like clockwork.
lines.zh: : 就像时钟一样准。

lines.en: : And I didn’t even need to sleep with anybody.
lines.zh: : 而且我甚至不需要和谁上床。

lines.en: : Congrats, Maya. I don’t know if I’m more upset that I lost or that {i}I{/i} didn’t get to experience five full minutes of you saying nice things to me.
lines.zh: : 恭喜，Maya。{i}我{/i}不知道我更难过的是自己输了，还是没能体验整整五分钟你对我说好话。

lines.en: scene benicetosensei57
: Maybe later. I’m in a good mood now. Sorry if that breaks your heart.
lines.zh: : 也许以后吧。我现在心情好。如果那让你心碎的话，抱歉咯。

lines.en: : Only a little.
lines.zh: : 只有一点点。

lines.en: : Nice job, Maya. Your victory ties the game at 2-2.
lines.zh: : 干得漂亮，Maya。你的胜利把比分扳成了 2-2。

lines.en: Otoha
lines.zh: Otoha

lines.en: $ dormwars5floor2points += 1
$ otohahappywin = True
: It’s a tough choice, but...
lines.zh: : 这是个艰难的选择，不过……

lines.en: : I think Otoha wins this one.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这场是 Otoha 赢。

lines.en: scene benicetosensei58
: She...does?
lines.zh: : 她……赢了？
: 我赢了？……

lines.en: : Yeah. But that doesn’t mean our talk didn’t make me feel happy as well, Maya.
lines.zh: : 嗯。不过这不代表我们的谈话没让我开心，Maya。

lines.en: scene benicetosensei59
: It just made me feel...all sorts of things. It’s complicated.
lines.zh: : 它只是让我感觉到……各种各样的东西。很复杂。

lines.en: : With Otoha, I feel like I can relax. And I’m not sure just how similar that is to happiness, but hers was the conversation that I felt like I needed a little more right now.
lines.zh: : 和 Otoha 在一起，我觉得自己能放松。我不确定那和幸福有多相似，但她的那场对话，是此刻我觉得自己更需要一些的。

lines.en: : Well...okay.
lines.zh: : 那……好吧。

lines.en: scene benicetosensei60
: If that’s what...you think is best.
lines.zh: : 如果那是……你觉得最好的选择。

lines.en: : I assure you, I am just as shocked as you.
lines.zh: : 我向你保证，我和你一样震惊。

lines.en: : There’s nothing to feel shocked about, Otoha! You made me feel good just now too.
lines.zh: : 没什么好震惊的，Otoha！你刚才也让我感觉很好。

lines.en: : And with your win, I’m sure the entirety of the second floor is going to be happy since you guys have managed to take a 3-1 lead!
lines.zh: : 而有了你这场的胜利，我相信二楼全员都会很高兴，因为你们已经把比分拉到了 3-1 领先！

lines.en: Ayane
lines.zh: Ayane

lines.en: $ dormwars5floor1points += 1
$ ayanehappywin = True
: You do.
lines.zh: : 是你。

lines.en: scene benicetosensei61
: Congrats, Maya! I knew you-
lines.zh: : 恭喜，Maya！我就知道你——

lines.en: scene benicetosensei62
: ...what?
: You make me the happiest, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 你让我最幸福，Ayane。

lines.en: scene benicetosensei63
: But I’m not...
lines.zh: : 可我不是……

lines.en: : I wasn’t in the contest. You can’t-
lines.zh: : 我没有参加比赛。你不能——

lines.en: : All you asked is who makes me the happiest. And there is no one I know who brings me more consistent joy than you.
lines.zh: : 你问的只是谁让我最幸福。而在我认识的人里，没有人比你带给我更持久的快乐。

lines.en: scene benicetosensei64
: Thank you for always being there for me.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你一直陪在我身边。

lines.en: : I love you.
lines.zh: : 我爱你。

lines.en: scene benicetosensei65
: Oh, damn.
lines.zh: : 哦，天啊。

lines.en: : Oh, damn...
lines.zh: : 哦，天啊……

lines.en: : Love you too...Sensei...
lines.zh: : 我也爱你……Sensei……

lines.en: : You...have no idea how...how much I needed to...hear that...
lines.zh: : 你……根本不知道我有多……多需要听到这句话……

lines.en: scene benicetosensei66
: Uhhhhhh...
lines.zh: : 呃呃呃……

lines.en: : Please excuse me.
lines.zh: : 失陪一下。

lines.en: scene benicetosensei67
: Well, that was dramatic.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那可真戏剧性。

lines.en: : You guys don’t mind, right? That there’s no {i}real{/i} winner of the contest?
lines.zh: : 你们不介意吧？这场比赛没有{i}真正{/i}的赢家？

lines.en: scene benicetosensei68
: I’m fine tying with Maya. I never really expected to win anyway.
lines.zh: : 和 Maya 打平我没意见。反正我从没真的指望能赢。

lines.en: : Just keep Ayane as the winner and give the point to the first floor so we can go into the next round tied. Sound good?
lines.zh: : 就把 Ayane 当赢家，把那一分给一楼，这样我们进入下一轮时是平局。行吗？

lines.en: : I don’t really care about the score, but that option is closer to me winning, so I will accept.
lines.zh: : 我不太在乎比分，不过那个选项更接近我赢，所以我接受。

lines.en: scene black
: Done deal then! I’m gonna go meet up with Nodoka and make sure she isn’t about to throw herself off the roof. Later, guys! It’s been fun!
lines.zh: : 那就这么定了！我要去找 Nodoka，确认她没有正打算从屋顶跳下去。回见，各位！今天很开心！

lines.en: : Yeah...
: It has certainly {i}been.{/i}
lines.zh: : 确实很{i}开心{/i}。

lines.en: $ dormwarsfive6 = True
jump dormwarsfive7
scene black
: On that note, though — it’s time to start heading outside! And hope that Molly and Ami don’t actually die!
lines.zh: : 那么，话虽如此——是时候出发去室外了！然后祈祷 Molly 和 Ami 不会真的死掉！

lines.en: : Is this Death Ball thing actually that scary? I still haven’t seen it.
lines.zh: : 这个死亡球真有那么吓人吗？我还没见过呢。

lines.en: : Oh, you sweet summer child.
lines.zh: : 哦，你这单纯的孩子。

lines.en: : Don’t listen to Otoha. The Death Ball is nice. It’s just...misunderstood.
lines.zh: : 别听 Otoha 的。死亡球很可爱。它只是……被误解了。

jump dormwarsfive7
